note: LinkedIn GTM building blocks: post hook shapes, content-type rotation, warming stages, connection-note and DM skeletons, the sell-by-chat phase spine, safety caps, and (from the call-booking augment) the profile conversion layer, lead-magnet post mechanics, niche first-touch openers, and anti-patterns. This bank is authored, not measured — reply-rate, reach, and calls-per-day figures circulating with these systems are vendor claims or rules of thumb, not results from our accounts, and agents must not present anything here as 'proven'. A fuller step-by-step playbook lives in the shared skills shelf as the linkedin-gtm skill; this bank is only the rows agents sample from. Hard rules that travel with every row: LinkedIn's terms prohibit unauthorized automation and scraping, so every outbound item is a human-approved draft, comment/connection caps are ceilings not targets, 'auto' posting modes and third-party follower/commenter scrapers are never used, every promised lead-magnet DM is actually fulfilled, scarcity and urgency lines are used only when literally true, and every claim, credential, or case-study number in a profile or message must be real. Slots are UPPERCASE so an unfilled template trips the placeholder check in src/lib/services/deliverables/acceptance-contracts.ts.

hookShapes.name: Anaphora
hookShapes.shape: A repeated opening phrase that builds rhythm across the first lines.

hookShapes.name: Obituary
hookShapes.shape: Declares an old practice dead and explains what replaces it.

hookShapes.name: Year-over-year pivot
hookShapes.shape: Contrasts what you did in an earlier year with what you do now.

hookShapes.name: Curiosity gap
hookShapes.shape: States a surprising result without explaining it until the body.

hookShapes.name: List reveal
hookShapes.shape: Promises a numbered set of things the reader does not know about a topic.

hookShapes.name: Confession
hookShapes.shape: Admits you were wrong about something you said publicly.

hookShapes.name: Contrarian
hookShapes.shape: Takes a genuinely held position most of the audience would push back on.

hookShapes.name: Before-after
hookShapes.shape: Shows a transformation anchored by specific before and after numbers.

hookShapes.name: One question
hookShapes.shape: Opens with a single question the reader cannot answer without reading on.

hookShapes.name: Cold open
hookShapes.shape: Drops the reader into a scene mid-action before any context.

postSkeleton.name: Post skeleton
postSkeleton.template:
[HOOK IN THE FIRST TWO LINES THAT EARNS THE SEE MORE CLICK]

[BODY AS A STORY OR ARGUMENT WITH SPECIFIC NUMBERS]

[CLOSING QUESTION OR RESOURCE THAT GIVES A REASON TO COMMENT]
postSkeleton.why: Only the first two lines render before the fold; the body earns the read; the close earns the comment. Keep the whole post between nine hundred and thirteen hundred characters with paragraphs of at most three lines.

contentTypes.role: Most converting; underproduced because it feels like boasting

contentTypes.what: A mental model or process the audience can apply

contentTypes.role: Draws the most comments and DMs

contentTypes.what: A real experience turned into a lesson
contentTypes.role: Best for reach and follower growth

weeklyRotation: two proof or framework posts plus one story or authority post; three posts per week minimum

warmingStages.meaning: has seen your name and content in their feed

connectionNote.name: Connection note
connectionNote.template: [SPECIFIC REFERENCE TO THEIR POST OR JOB CHANGE OR COMPANY SIGNAL] [ONE SENTENCE OF SHARED GROUND WITHOUT ANY PITCH]
connectionNote.why: Under two hundred characters, anchored to something real, and never a pitch or a profile-scraper phrase.

dmSequence.timing: one to three days after acceptance
dmSequence.job: reference why you connected, offer something relevant, end with an open question
share a relevant resource with one sentence of context; no ask

dmSequence.timing: five to seven days after message two
only after a positive reply without commitment
dmSequence.job: move to the calendar within one or two more messages

sellByChat.rule: reference shared context and ask about their situation; no offer yet
two or three questions that surface whether the problem exists; listen, do not pitch
once the problem is confirmed, one sentence of offer and ask if a quick call is worth it
calendar link only after an explicit yes; never before the pivot

safetyCaps.note: human-approved drafts only; never an auto mode

safetyCaps.cap: 20 on newer accounts, up to 40 on warmed accounts, never 50
safetyCaps.note: each note is a reviewed draft

safetyCaps.cap: reach out within 24 hours of a comment; immediately on a share
safetyCaps.note: engagement-triggered messages are warm, not cold; still human-approved

voiceRules: no AI vocabulary such as leverage, delve, streamline, harness, unlock, foster, synergy
every output is a draft until a human approves it

profileLayer.template: I help [ICP] achieve [SPECIFIC OUTCOME] in [TIMEFRAME] with [UNIQUE MECHANISM]
profileLayer.why: the headline renders in search results, post bylines, and DM previews; an optional guarantee or differentiator can follow the main promise, and every accolade must be real
the wide-net variant when the ICP spans several segments; still outcome plus named method, never a bare job title

profileLayer.template: one line of real social proof, the offer stated directly, no questions, sized to the platform's banner dimensions with the left quarter left clear of text for the profile photo overlay
profileLayer.why: the banner is the profile's billboard; direct statements outperform questions and the avatar covers the lower-left area

profileLayer.template: three slots: the best-performing educational post with a clear call to action, one real case study or testimonial, and one free resource such as a template or guide
profileLayer.why: most profiles leave it empty; it is the credibility shelf a DM recipient checks before replying

profileLayer.template:
[PATTERN INTERRUPT ADDRESSED TO THE ICP]

[ONE CREDIBILITY SENTENCE WITH A REAL NUMBER AND TIMEFRAME]

If you're like most [ICP PLURAL] I work with, you're probably:
[THREE SPECIFIC PAIN POINTS AS BULLETS]

Here's what makes us different: [UNIQUE MECHANISM IN TWO TO THREE SENTENCES]

Recent results:
[THREE REAL CLIENT RESULTS AS BULLETS]

Ready to [DESIRED OUTCOME]? DM me [TRIGGER WORD] for [SPECIFIC NEXT STEP]
profileLayer.why: a short-form sales letter: interrupt, credibility, pain recognition, solution bridge, proof, trigger-word CTA; every number must be real

profileLayer.template: four coordinated slots: the profile custom button, a banner CTA, the About-section closing CTA, and Featured-section links
profileLayer.why: prospects arrive at different engagement depths; each surface catches a different one

leadMagnetPosts.template:
[BOLD REAL CLAIM ABOUT WHAT THE RESOURCE DELIVERS]

Inside:
[THREE TO FIVE SPECIFIC COMPONENTS AS ARROWS]

[WHY IT WORKS OR ONE LINE OF REAL PROOF]

Comment [KEYWORD] and connect with me and I'll send it over.
leadMagnetPosts.why: the comment-plus-connect ask builds both reach and a DM channel; the promised DM must actually be sent, by a human or a human-approved draft

leadMagnetPosts.template: lead-magnet hooks trigger one of three emotions: desire (a concrete result someone wants), curiosity (a named strategy they have not heard of), or fear (a costly mistake they may be making)
leadMagnetPosts.why: the hook's only jobs are stopping the scroll and earning the read-more click

leadMagnetPosts.template: two parts: the necessary actions (comment [KEYWORD] plus follow or connect) and an optional bonus action for a bonus reward (repost for an extra resource)
leadMagnetPosts.why: each added step adds friction and cuts comments; keep the necessary actions minimal and honest

leadMagnetPosts.template: a short sped-up workflow video, a deliberately blurred screenshot, or a curiosity-building visual of the real resource
leadMagnetPosts.why: previews of the actual asset raise conversion; never preview something the resource does not contain

leadMagnetPosts.template:
Here's the [RESOURCE NAME] [FIRST NAME]: [LINK]

Curious - [SPECIFIC RELATED QUESTION]
leadMagnetPosts.why: delivers immediately, then opens a real conversation; the alternative close offers a relevant free call only when genuinely on offer

leadMagnetPosts.template: reply to their comment with a casual delivery line and the link, or send a connection request whose note contains the resource link and one related question
leadMagnetPosts.why: delivery must not be held hostage to the connection; the promise was the resource

nicheOpeners.audience: any service with a real named result
nicheOpeners.template: Hey [FIRST NAME] - I'll be direct rather than waste your time: I work with [ICP] to [OUTCOME]. We helped [REAL CLIENT] go from [REAL BEFORE] to [REAL AFTER] in [TIMEFRAME], and [THEIR COMPANY] looks similar. Against me telling you how we did it?
nicheOpeners.why: the negative-phrased close lowers the cost of replying; the case numbers must be real

nicheOpeners.template: Hey [FIRST NAME], good to connect. Curious - [ONE SPECIFIC QUESTION ABOUT A METRIC THEY LIKELY CARE ABOUT]?
nicheOpeners.why: one question, no pitch; the reply starts a sell-by-chat sequence, not a broadcast

nicheOpeners.audience: anyone who genuinely attended the same event
nicheOpeners.template: Hey [FIRST NAME] - saw you were at [EVENT NAME] too. Have you been working on [EVENT TOPIC] a while or just getting started?
nicheOpeners.why: honest shared context; only usable when you actually attended or watched the event

nicheOpeners.audience: recruiters and services targeting recently funded companies
nicheOpeners.template: Congrats on the [ROUND NAME], [FIRST NAME]. When I raised mine the focus went straight to building out the team - is that where [COMPANY] is heading or investing elsewhere?
nicheOpeners.why: public funding news is a legitimate signal; the personal framing is only usable if you genuinely have that experience

nicheOpeners.template: Bit out of left field, but I saw your [ROLE NAME] listing on [JOB PLATFORM]. We recently filled the same role for [REAL CLIENT] - shortlist in [REAL TIMEFRAME]. Worth us putting a shortlist together for you?
nicheOpeners.why: a live listing is explicit intent; the placement claim and any retention figure must be real

nicheOpeners.template: Hey [FIRST NAME] - just searched [COMPANY NAME] on Google and noticed you aren't ranking for [KEYWORD ONE] or [KEYWORD TWO]. Something you've thought about?
nicheOpeners.why: a checkable, specific observation about their world; do the search for real before sending

nicheOpeners.template: Hey [FIRST NAME] - saw your site runs on [SITE BUILDER]. I have a [INDUSTRY] template that [REAL EXAMPLE COMPANY] uses - happy to send it over, and to apply it for you at no charge if you don't have anyone to implement it.
nicheOpeners.why: a real free deliverable with zero friction; only offer the free implementation if you will actually do it

nicheOpeners.template: Hey [FIRST NAME] - I've followed [COMPANY] for a bit and noticed [SPECIFIC OBSERVABLE SIGNAL]. Curious whether that's intentional or you're running into [SPECIFIC SCALING PROBLEM]? Have a guide on [SOLVING THAT PROBLEM] if useful.
nicheOpeners.why: the signal must be genuinely observable (public headcount, posting cadence); the guide is given without conditions

nicheOpeners.template: Hey [FIRST NAME] - I build [PRODUCT CATEGORY] for [ICP] and I'm looking for blunt feedback, not a sale. I made [ONE SENTENCE PRODUCT DESCRIPTION] - if [PROBLEM AREA] is something your team spends time on, would love your take.
nicheOpeners.why: a feedback ask is honest only when feedback is genuinely wanted and acted on; it must not be a disguised pitch

antiPatterns.why: openers that invent a mutual source (a-little-birdy-told-me) and then joke that the sender actually scraped the recipient's profile are deception built on a terms violation; never manufacture false familiarity

antiPatterns.pattern: AI voice notes passed off as personal
antiPatterns.why: sending synthetic voice messages that imitate a spontaneous human note is undisclosed impersonation; voice notes are recorded by the actual human or not sent

third-party follower scrapers, commenter scrapers, and fully automated DM sequencers violate LinkedIn terms and get accounts restricted; competitor-engagement signals may only be gathered manually within the platform
free-for-24-hours and limited-to-N-copies lines are only usable when literally enforced; fake limits are a lie the audience eventually catches
invented client results, revenue screenshots, retention rates, or credentials in profiles, posts, or DMs are fraud; real numbers or no claim
